'''Star Tours Flight 819''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1E at 1320 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1415.
